title: Daily Market Briefing
text:
BOTTOM LINE — Risk-on, semis ripped, oil crashed. A Hormuz-deal headline crushed crude 5.2%, dragging yields lower, and that macro relief plus Palantir's 29.45% AI blowout ignited a broad melt-up — SOXX +6.80% led, every major index closed at fresh records, and the tape rejected the defensive rotation entirely.

INDICES — VIX 16.5, below its 17.3 20-day MA. SOXX +6.80%, QQQ +3.40%, IWM +1.85%, SPY +1.80%, DIA +1.73%. Large > small by 1.55pp per STYLE line. WTI crude -5.19% was the cross-asset headline; 10-year yield fell to ~4.6%. SPY and QQQ hold well above their 200-day MAs.

VOLUME — SPY vol_ratio 1.5x, QQQ 1.5x, DIA 1.9x — all elevated with price up = accumulation. IWM at 1.0x shows small caps were ignored. Sector flows: XLV 1.7x, XLI 1.6x, XLB 1.6x volume up; XLC 0.9x volume down despite gains. FNGS 3.4x on +4.11% confirms AI-money chasing.

SECTORS & ROTATION — XLK Technology +4.98%, XLB Materials +1.94%, XLI Industrials +1.77%, XLF Financials +0.87%, XLC Comms +0.63%, XLP Staples +0.60%, XLY Discretionary +0.07%, XLRE Real Estate -0.02%, XLV Healthcare -0.09%, XLE Energy -0.46%, XLU Utilities -0.56%. Top industries: DRAM +7.35%, SOXX +6.80%; bottom: USO -5.19%, WGMI -3.65%. Money in semis and industrials, out of energy and utilities — label: AI hardware leading.

POSITIONING — SPY PCR 1.19 elevated = protection demand; QQQ PCR 0.79 complacent. QQQ GEX flip at 703, spot 3.40% above — above flip, dealer gamma amplifies upside. IV skew positive on all major indices. MOVE 77.6 vs 70.0 MA flags bond vol stress despite the rally. VIX below its 20-day = complacency creeping in.

CROSS-ASSET — Oil -5.19% and nat gas -3.36% while equities hit records — the Hormuz-deal transmission crushed energy equities (XLE -0.46%) but turbocharged rate-sensitive tech. Dollar flat at -0.04% while gold +0.66% and silver +2.63% — metals rallying despite no dollar weakness, a quiet inflation-hedge bid.

SIGNALS & WATCH — Greed at 65.8/100. Top movers: PLTR +29.45% on AI earnings, MRVL +12.81% on unusual call volume, INTC +10.84% with no catalyst — momentum continuation after -18.29% drift. VST -8.15% with 3.0x vol spike on power-group distribution; FANG -3.46% on energy rout. Watch: MRVL +12.81% — gamma proximity on QQQ names; SOXX +6.80% — DRAM 7.35% leading but volume only 0.6x, low conviction; XLV +1.7x volume despite -0.09% — defensive accumulation signaling rotation risk.
